final: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS REAL) / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS films FROM film WHERE rental_duration >= 5 GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS bm FROM per_rating) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_rate_per_day, p.films, p.avg_rate_per_day / b.bm AS ratio_to_benchmark FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE b.bm IS NOT NULL
